what: Xylem makes water technology: pumps that move water and wastewater, treatment systems, smart meters that measure consumption, and analytics for water utilities.
customers: Municipal water and wastewater utilities, industrial water users, building services and agriculture.
money: pumps, treatment and transport for utilities
smart water meters and network analytics
pumps for buildings, industry and agriculture
moat: Equipment specified into municipal water systems with decades-long replacement cycles, plus smart meter networks that lock utilities into its data platform.
risks: Municipal spending depends on government budgets and bond issuance
Return on invested capital of about 7% reflects the Evoqua acquisition's cost base
Revenue growth of about 6% is steady rather than fast
opportunities: Analysts see about 32% upside from current levels
Water scarcity and ageing pipe networks drive structural investment
Smart metering backlog provides multi-year revenue visibility
watch: Orders and backlog in Measurement and Control Solutions.
